workflow.note: Good start. Before I approve: please add al-Tabari's explanation of «لحمًا طريًّا» (fish) and «حلية» (pearls and coral) as a tafsir excerpt, so visitors read the verse through early commentary rather than modern claims. Keep 25:53 out of this card as agreed.

explanation.en: The Quran describes the sea as placed in service to people: from it they eat fresh food and bring out ornaments to wear, and on it ships cut their way (16:14). Ships sail on it by Allah's command, so that people can seek His bounty and perhaps be grateful (45:12).
explanation.ar: يصف القرآن البحر بأنه مسخّر للناس: يأكلون منه طعامًا طريًّا، ويستخرجون منه زينة يتحلّون بها، وتشقّه السفن في جريانها (النحل ١٤). وتجري السفن فيه بأمر الله ليطلب الناس من فضله، لعلهم يشكرون (الجاثية ١٢).
